title: Polish authorities find Russian missile remains at three sites following airspace incursion
summary: In the newest announcement, the Lublin District Prosecutor’s Office revealed that debris from Kh-101 cruise missiles was discovered at three sites in eastern Poland: Nowy Lipowiec, Rudnik, and Mołodycz. Initial findings also indicated that all missiles were manufactured in recent weeks at a manufacturing plant in the Russian city of Dubna.
